language.label: Web UI Language
language.help: Select the display language for the Web UI.

default_model.label: Default Model
default_model.help: Default text model. Examples: deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek-v4-flash, claude-sonnet-4-6, etc. DeepSeek currently recommends deepseek-v4-pro.

update_check_for_updates.label: Check For Updates
update_check_for_updates.help: Checks for the latest stable version in the background. Shows a toast notification when a new version is available and resources are complete.
